info.title: TaskFlow API
info.description: TaskFlow sharing contract. Errors use {error:{code,message}}. Bearer Session identifies user; every operation checks current project access. Nonmembers receive 404; members attempting owner-only operations receive 403. One owner per project, other participants are members. Only task creators may move/unassign tasks. X-Request-ID accompanies responses. Validation uses 400, not 422. Use HTTPS outside loopback. No cookie authentication. Unknown routes 404; unsupported methods 405. Paths match exactly.

get.description: Visible tasks: private unclassified tasks created by caller, plus tasks in projects currently owned by or shared with caller. Every page rechecks membership; old cursors never grant access. Array response; X-Next-Cursor omitted when exhausted. Cursor is bound to user and filters. Not a snapshot.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque X-Next-Cursor from previous response; keep the same filters and user.

parameters.name: has_due_date
parameters.description: Literal true/false; false cannot be combined with due ranges.

parameters.name: due_before
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound; must be greater than due_from.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Project UUID, or literal none for unclassified tasks. Omit for all own tasks. Invalid/empty/duplicate values return 400. Foreign or absent projects yield an empty array. Cursor is bound to this filter.

post.description: Owner comes from session and remains the immutable creator. Creating inside a project requires current access. Other members will be able to read/edit/delete the task.

delete.description: Owner only. Cannot remove the owner. Existing sessions lose subsequent project access immediately after commit.

post.description: Member leaves. Owner must transfer first (409 OWNER_REQUIRED). Tasks remain in the project.
Owner only; target must be a current member. Old owner becomes member. Pending invitations are revoked atomically.

get.description: Owner only; token never returned in this list.

post.description: Owner only; recipient must be a registered user who is not already a member. 24-hour single-use recipient-bound token, returned once. Reissuing revokes prior outstanding invitations for that recipient. No email sent.

delete.description: Owner only. Accepted tokens cannot be revoked; remove the member instead.

post.description: Authenticated intended recipient only. Invalid, expired, revoked, used or mismatched tokens return generic INVITATION_INVALID. Request bodies must not be logged.

email.description: Trimmed and lowercased; common unquoted ASCII address, 3–254 bytes.

password.description: 15–128 Unicode characters, at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, not whitespace-only.

access_token.description: Opaque revocable session credential, not a JWT.

id.description: Opaque task identifier; do not assume UUID formatting.

can_move.description: True only for the creator. Server separately authorizes source and target projects.

CreateTask.description: Title must contain non-whitespace text. Missing/null project_id means unclassified. Due dates must be RFC3339 within years 1–9999.

UpdateTask.description: At least one effective update is required. due_date/project_id: missing preserves, null clears, value sets. Other null fields preserve. Current version required; success increments it once, stale version gives 409. Title cannot be blank.

name.description: Trim before validation; 1–100 Unicode characters after trimming, no NUL.
Trimmed, 1–100 characters; null/missing preserves, no NUL.

description.description: Null/missing preserves; empty string clears; no NUL.

UpdateProject.description: At least one non-null field. Same-field concurrent edits use last-write-wins; projects have no version.

token.description: Returned only once on creation. Do not log or persist. Share as URL fragment.
